org.name: Over the Influence Recovery
org.tagline: You don't have to do it alone.
org.headline: Empowering moms in recovery to stop relapsing and start thriving.
org.mission: Over the Influence Recovery is a non-profit organization that supports mothers in recovery to live over the influence of drugs, shame, and regret and build a life they desire, create and love for themselves and their children. We empower women to stop relapsing, align their actions with their values, and join a fun and healthy community of mothers who thrive in recovery.

programs.name: T.H.R.I.V.E.
programs.summary: A six-month Peer Recovery Coaching program for women recovering from substance use disorder.
details: Weekly one-on-one sessions with an empowering recovery coach who helps you set and achieve your goals

programs.name: Online Recovery Support Group
programs.summary: A women-only online recovery group for women who want something different than AA or NA. Confidential and free.
details: Feel less lonely, isolated, or judged
Talk openly and honestly about your feelings
Connect with others with similar struggles and goals

cta.label: Register once to attend any meeting

programs.name: Individual Coaching (online or in person)
programs.summary: One-on-one attention at a pace and time that fits your schedule, with privacy and confidentiality.
details: Time for discussing specific issues and getting feedback from your coach
Scheduled at a time that works for you
A pace of recovery tailored to your life

programs.name: Thoughtful & Thrive (TnT) events
programs.summary: Monthly events focused on giving back or trying something new: homeless care bags, volunteering, painting, ferry rides, arts and crafts, and more.

events.title: Online Recovery Support Group
events.description: Women-only online recovery support group. Register once on Zoom to attend any meeting. Confidential and free.

reminder.title: OTI support group tonight

events.title: Here to Thrive 2026: An Evening of Impact and Vision
events.description: Celebrating mothers who thrive and the community that makes it possible. Dinner, dessert, and an inspiring evening of community, connection, and impact. Guest tickets $55. Dinner party attire (casual to fancy). Seating is limited.

events.title: Peer Recovery Coach Blueprint (1-week cohort)
events.description: Empowering peer supporters in SUD recovery with tools, confidence, and certification-aligned skills. 7.5 CE hours. Mon–Fri, 3:30–5:00 PM. For peer support specialists, individuals in recovery, and family members.

unscheduled.title: Thoughtful & Thrive (TnT) event
unscheduled.note: Held monthly for program participants. Dates are announced in the group and newsletter.

unscheduled.note: Saturdays at 10:00 AM. Next date coming soon.

phones.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
phones.description: Call or text for any emotional crisis, thoughts of suicide, or substance use crisis. Free and confidential.

phones.name: Never Use Alone (overdose prevention line)
phones.description: If you or someone you love is going to use, don't use alone. An operator stays on the line and sends help if you stop responding. No judgment.

phoneCategories.label: Crisis lines
phoneCategories.blurb: If you are in immediate danger, call 911.

training.name: Peer Recovery Coach Blueprint
training.schedule: Next cohort TBA · 1-week format, Mon–Fri 3:30–5:00 PM
training.audience: Peer support specialists, individuals in recovery, and family members
training.outcome: Skills to thrive in recovery spaces and support others in recovery. Aligned with California Medi-Cal Peer Support Specialist standards.

training.name: Hope as an Ethical Value
training.series: Code of Ethics for Peer Support Specialists
training.outcome: How to ethically inspire hope, hold hope for others, and share lived experience in ways that support dignity, self-determination, and recovery.

training.name: Digital Literacy 101
training.schedule: Saturdays 10:00 AM · next date coming soon
training.audience: Peer support specialists and participants who want to strengthen digital confidence
training.outcome: Organize digital files, navigate browsers, use free productivity tools, and recognize common online scams.

trainingNote: Over the Influence Recovery is CalMHSA-approved to provide Continuing Education (CE) hours for California's Certified Medi-Cal Peer Support Specialists (CMPSS). Courses are open statewide.

testimonials.name: Belinda
testimonials.quote: I've been through countless programs, but OTI has helped me more than all the others combined. Here, I finally feel worth, support, and real growth. I'm so grateful for my peer coach and the close-knit community that has changed my life.
